αἰδοίοιο: αἰδοῖος — revered, worthy of respect; masc. gen. sg., epic -οιο (= Attic -ου)
αἰπὰ: αἰπύς — steep, sheer; adj., neut. acc. pl., agreeing with ῥέεθρα: ’steep’
αἵματι: αἷμα — blood; neut. dat. sg.: ’with blood’, instrumental
αὐτοὶ: αὐτός — self; intensive pron., masc. nom. pl.: ’themselves’ · also intensive, in apposition to the subject ’we’: ’we ourselves’
αὐτοῦ: αὐτός — self; masc. gen. sg.: ’of himself, him’ · also the adverb αὐτοῦ, ’there, on the spot’ · also intensive gen. sg. after a possessive, of the speaker: ’of myself’ (ἐμὸν αὐτοῦ ’my own’) · also intensive gen. sg. after a possessive, of a third person: ’his own’ (ἑῷ αὐτοῦ θυμῷ ’his own heart’) · also masc. gen. sg. standing for a masculine thing: ’of it’, ’upon it’ (ἐπ’ αὐτοῦ ’upon it’) · also gen. sg. standing for a thing, partitive after τὸ μέν: ’of it’ (τὸ μὲν αὐτοῦ ’one part of it’) · also gen. sg. standing apart from its noun: ’his’ (διὰ δ’ αὐτοῦ … ὀδόντων ’through his teeth’) · also gen. sg., object of ἀπήμβροτε: ’him’ (αὐτοῦ ἀπήμβροτε ’missed him’) · also gen. sg. standing for a neuter thing: ’from it’ (ἐκ … αὐτοῦ ’from it’) · also intensive gen. sg. after the reflexive ἕο: ’himself’ (ἕο αὐτοῦ ’of himself’)
αὐτὰρ: αὐτάρ — but, and then; epic conj. (= Attic δέ, ἀλλά)
αὐτὸς: αὐτός — self; masc. nom. sg., intensive with the subject: ’myself, yourself, himself’
αὖ: αὖ — again, in turn, back; adv., shorter form of αὖτε
αὖτις: αὖτις — back, again, once more; adv. (= αὖθις)
βάλε: βάλλω — throw, cast; aor. 3 sg., unaugmented (= ἔβαλε): ’threw, dashed’ · also ’hit, struck’ a target (κατ’ ἀσπίδα … βάλε ’hit the shield’) · also ’put on, fitted’ in tmesis (ἀμφ’ ὀχέεσσι … βάλε ’fitted to the chariot’)
βάλες: βάλλω — throw, strike; aor. 2 sg. act., unaugmented (= ἔβαλες): ’you struck down, laid low’
βάλλεο: βάλλω — throw, put; mid. put (in one’s mind); pres. imper. 2 sg. mid., epic -εο (= Attic βάλλου)
βράχε: βράχω — clash, ring, crash; aor. 3 sg., unaugmented (= ἔβραχε): ’clashed’
γέροντος: γέρων — old man, elder; masc. gen. sg. (ἁλίοιο γέροντος ’of the old man of the sea’)
γαίῃ: γαῖα — earth, ground; fem. dat. sg., Ionic -ῃ (= Attic γαίᾳ)
γε: γε — at least, in fact, indeed; limiting/emphatic particle
γείνατο: γείνομαι — beget, bear (of a mother); aor. 3 sg. mid., epic, unaugmented (= ἐγείνατο) · also of a father: ’begot, fathered’
γούνατ: γόνυ — knee; neut. acc. pl., elided (γούνατ’ = γούνατα); ’loosen the knees’ means ’kill, unstring’ · also neut. nom. pl., subject of a verb of motion: ’(my) knees’ (γούνατα ὀρώρῃ) · also neut. nom. pl., subject of a passive: ’(the) knees are hampered’ (γούνατα βλάβεται)
γούνων: γόνυ — knee; neut. gen. pl., epic γούνων (= Attic γονάτων); gen. of the part grasped, after λαβέ · also neut. gen. pl., with λίσσομαι ’beseech’: ’at the knees’ · also neut. gen. pl., gen. of the part touched, after ἅπτομαι: ’took hold of the knees’ · also neut. gen. pl., depending on ἀντίος: ’facing the knees’
γῆ: γῆ — earth, land; also Γῆ, the goddess Earth; fem. nom. sg. (epic γαῖα)
δ: δέ (elided δ’) — and, but · also the elided suffix -δε, ’to, toward’ (Ἄργος δ’ ’to Argos’)
δέ: δέ — and, but; connective particle · also the enclitic suffix -δε, ’to, toward’ (Οὔλυμπον δέ ’to Olympus’)
δίωκε: διώκω — drive on, chase, pursue; impf. 3 sg., unaugmented (= Attic ἐδίωκε): ’drove on’
δαίμονι: δαίμων — divinity, god, divine power; masc. dat. sg.
δαίμων: δαίμων — a god, a divine power (often unnamed); masc. nom. sg.
δαείω: δάω — learn, come to know (aor. ἐδάην); aor. 2 pass. subj. 1 sg., epic lengthened (δαείω = Attic δαῶ), after ὄφρα: ’that I may learn’
δαρδανίδαο: Δαρδανίδης — descendant of Dardanus, a Trojan; masc. gen. sg., epic -αο (= Attic -ου), with Πριάμοιο
δειδιότες: δείδω — fear, dread; perf. part. masc. nom. pl., epic δειδιότες (= Attic δεδιότες): ’dreading’, + acc.
δεινοῖο: δεινός — dread, terrible; masc./neut. gen. sg., epic -οιο (= Attic -οῦ), agreeing with πελώρου
δημήτερος: Δημήτηρ — Demeter, goddess of grain; fem. gen. sg., epic Δημήτερος (= Attic Δήμητρος); Δημήτερος ἀκτή is ’grain’
δινήεντος: δινήεις — eddying, whirling; masc. gen. sg., agreeing with Ξάνθου
διογενὴς: διογενής — sprung from Zeus, Zeus-born; masc. nom. sg., epithet of heroes
διὶ: Ζεύς — Zeus, chief of the gods; masc. dat. sg. Διί
δουρί: δόρυ — spear, shaft; neut. dat. sg., epic δουρί (= Attic δόρατι)
δουρὸς: δόρυ — spear, wood, timber; neut. gen. sg., epic stem δουρ- (= Attic δόρατος)
δυωδεκάτη: δυωδέκατος (Attic δωδέκατος) — twelfth; fem. nom. sg., agreeing with ἠώς: ’the twelfth dawn’
δυώδεκα: δώδεκα — twelve; indeclinable numeral, epic δυώδεκα (= Attic δώδεκα)
δόρυ: δόρυ — wood, tree-trunk; spear (a shaft of wood); neut. nom./acc. sg. (gen. δουρός)
δύω: δύο — two; numeral, epic by-form δύω, indeclinable · also δύω — go into, put on (armour); aor. subj. 1 sg. act., short-vowel subj. after ὄφρ’ ἂν: ’I put on’ (τεύχεα δύω)
δὲ: δέ — and, but; connective particle · also the enclitic suffix -δε, ’to, toward’ (οἶκον δὲ ’homeward’)
δὴ: δή — indeed, now, in fact; emphatic particle
δῆσε: δέω — bind, tie; aor. 3 sg. act., unaugmented (= ἔδησε): ’tied’
δῖαν: δῖος — heavenly, divine; fem. acc. sg., epithet of the sea (ἅλα δῖαν ’the divine brine’) · also fem. acc. sg. of a land (Ἤλιδα δῖαν ’heavenly Elis’) · also fem. acc. sg., epithet of a city (Ἀρίσβην δῖαν ’heavenly Arisbe’) · also fem. acc. sg., epithet of Dawn (Ἠῶ δῖαν ’heavenly Dawn’)
δῖος: δῖος — heavenly, divine, illustrious; masc. nom. sg., epithet of heroes (= fem. δῖα)
δῶκε: δίδωμι — give; aor. 3 sg. act., unaugmented (= Attic ἔδωκε)
δῶμα: δῶμα — house, hall, dwelling; neut. acc. sg.
εἰλήλουθα: ἔρχομαι — come, go; redupl. perf. 1 sg., epic (= Attic ἐλήλυθα): ’I have come’
εἰμι: εἰμί — be; pres. 1 sg., enclitic (accent goes to the word before): ’I am’
εἰς: εἰς — into, to; prep. + acc. · also εἰς ὅ (κεν) + subj., ’until’ (εἰς ὅ κεν … ἕλωμεν ’until we take’) · also + acc. of respect: ’in’ (εἰς ὦπα ’in face’) · also + gen., with δόμον understood: ’to the house of’ (εἰς Ἄϊδος ’to Hades’) · also εἰς ὅ κ’ + opt., ’until … should’ (εἰς ὅ κ’ … ἕλοιεν ’until they should take’) · also εἰμί — be; pres. 2 sg., epic εἶς (= Attic εἶ): ’you are’ (λελασμένος εἰς ’you have forgotten’, with a perfect participle)
εἶεν: εἰμί — be; pres. opt. 3 pl., in a wish with a dat. of the person: ’may (they) be’ (αἲ γὰρ … μοι … εἶεν ’would that I had …’) · in a remote condition: ’if there were’
εἶπε: εἶπον — say, speak; aor. 3 sg., without movable ν (= Attic εἶπεν)
ζεύς: Ζεύς — Zeus, king of the gods; nom. sg.
ζωοὺς: ζωός — alive, living; masc. acc. pl., epic (= Attic ζῶντας), predicate with νῶϊ: ’alive’
θάνατόν: θάνατος — death; masc. acc. sg., enclitic accent before τε: ’death’ · also accented before the enclitic γε: θάνατόν γε ’death at least’ · also accented before the enclitic νύ: ’death indeed’
θανόντος: θνῄσκω — die; aor. part. act. masc. gen. sg. (aor. ἔθανον): ’dead’, lit. ’having died’
θαῦμα: θαῦμα — wonder, marvel; neut. nom. sg., in apposition: ’a wonder to see’ · also neut. acc. sg., object of ὁρῶμαι: ’a wonder’
θεινομένων: θείνω — strike, smite, wound; pres. part. pass. gen. pl., dependent on στόνος: ’of those being struck’
θεὸς: θεός — god; masc. nom. sg., subject: ’the god’ (common gender; may also name a goddess) · also masc. nom. sg. in a comparison: ’(like) a god’ (θεὸς ὣς)
θυμόν: θυμός — heart, spirit, soul, anger; acc. sg. · also the life that leaves the body: ’life’ (θυμὸν ἀποπνείων ’breathing out his life’)
θυμὸν: θυμός — heart, spirit, soul; acc. sg. · also the life that leaves the body: ’life’ (θυμὸν ὀλέσσῃ ’lose his life’) · also acc. of respect: ’in heart’ (θυμὸν ἐχώσατο ’was angered in heart’)
θυμῷ: θυμός — heart, spirit, soul; dat. sg.
θύραζε: θύραζε — to the outside, out of doors; adv., directional suffix -δε (= -ζε after a vowel)
κάματος: κάματος — weariness, toil, fatigue; masc. nom. sg.
κάμε: κάμνω — toil, labour, grow weary; aor. 3 sg., unaugmented (= ἔκαμε): ’toiled’ (κάμε τεύχων ’toiled at making’) · also with a direct object: ’made, wrought’ (πάνθ’ ὅπλα κάμε ’made all the arms’)
καθ: κατά (elided καθ’) — down, down to; prep. + acc., aspirated before rough breathing (καθ’ ἕδρας ’down to their seats’) · also + acc., ’through, throughout’ (καθ’ ὕλην ’through the wood’) · also + gen., ’down from’ (καθ’ ἵππων) · also + acc., ’according to’ (καθ’ ἡμέτερον νόον ’according to our mind’) · also + acc., ’at, among’, of what one is busy with (καθ’ ἵππους ’among his horses’) · also + acc. of the place struck: ’in’ (καθ’ ἧπαρ ’in the liver’)
κακὰ: κακός — bad, evil; neut. acc. pl. as a noun: ’evils’ · also neut. acc. pl., adj. with ἔργα: ’evil (deeds)’
κακὸν: κακός — bad, evil, harmful; neut. acc. sg. · also masc. acc. sg., ’a coward, a base man’ (κακὸν ὣς δειδίσσεσθαι ’to frighten like a coward’) · also masc. acc. sg., adj. with a noun: ’evil’ (κακὸν οἶτον ’an evil doom’) · also neut. nom. sg., predicate noun: ’an evil’ · also neut. nom. sg., adj. with ὄναρ: ’evil (dream)’ · also neut. nom. sg. as a noun, subject: ’evil’ (κακὸν κακῷ ’evil upon evil’)
κατάγειν: κατάγω — lead down, bring down; pres. inf. act., of purpose: ’to take down’
κατεσθίει: κατεσθίω — eat up, devour; pres. 3 sg.
κατὰ: κατά — down, throughout, along; + acc./gen.; also a preverb in tmesis (κατὰ … ἔκηα ’burned up’) · also + acc. in κατὰ μοῖραν ’according to what is fitting’ · also + acc. of purpose, ’for’ (κατὰ δαῖτα ’for a feast’) · also + acc. of respect, ’in’ (κατὰ θυμόν ’in heart’) · also + acc., distributive: ’by’ (κατὰ φῦλα ’by tribes’) · also + acc. of place: ’in, among’ (κατὰ ὑσμίνας ’in the battles’) · also κατὰ σφέας ’by themselves, apart’ · also + acc. of the place struck: ’in, on’ (κατὰ δεξιὸν ὦμον ’in the right shoulder’) · also + acc., ’into, toward’ (κατὰ πληθὺν ’toward the throng’) · also + acc., ’according to, after’ (κατὰ θυμόν ’after one’s heart’) · also κατὰ ἶσα ’equally, evenly’ (κατὰ ἶσα μάχην ἐτάνυσσε) · also + acc. of the part of a weapon: ’at’ (κατὰ στόμα ’at the tip’) · also + acc., ’through, out along’ (κατὰ ῥῖνας ’out through the nostrils’) · also + gen., ’down into’ (κατὰ γαίης ’down into the earth’) · also κατὰ πάμπαν, adverbial: ’altogether, utterly’
κε: κε(ν) — epic particle marking a conditioned or potential action (= Attic ἄν); with the subj. in purpose and general clauses · also + subj. in a temporal or conditional clause: ’whenever’, ’if’ · also + fut. indic. in a main clause: ’shall’ (κε μελήσεται ’will concern’) · also + opt., potential: ’would’ (τώ κε … ἠμύσειε ’then would collapse’) · also with an impf. indic., past potential: ’would have’ (κε … ἔπασχον ’I would have suffered’) · also with an aor. indic., past potential: ’would have’ (κε σήκασθεν ’would have been penned’) · also + opt. in a condition after εἰ: ’if … might’ · also εἰς ὅ κε + aor. subj.: ’until’ (εἰς ὅ κε … εὕρωμεν ’until we find’) · also ἤ κε … ἦ κε + subj., in an indirect alternative question: ’whether … or’ · also ὄφρά κε + opt. in a purpose clause after a past tense: ’so that … might’ (ὄφρά κε … θείη ’so that he might make’) · also εἷός κε + subj.: ’until’ (εἷός κε … ἵκηαι ’until you reach’) · also ὄφρά κε + subj., temporal: ’until’ (ὄφρά κε … ἔλθῃσι ’until … comes’)
κεῖθεν: κεῖθεν — from there, thence; adv. (= ἐκεῖθεν, with -θεν ’from’)
κούρους: κοῦρος — youth, young man; masc. acc. pl., Ionic (= Attic κόρους)
κρατερόν: κρατερός — strong, mighty; adj., masc. acc. sg. · also neut. nom. sg., agreeing with πένθος: ’strong (grief)’
κτεῖν: κτείνω — kill, slay; aor. 3 sg., unaugmented and elided (κτεῖν’ = κτεῖνε = Attic ἔκτεινε)
κόρυθός: κόρυς — helmet; fem. gen. sg. (accent shifted before the enclitic τε)
κύψας: κύπτω — bend forward, stoop; aor. part. act. masc. nom. sg.: ’having stooped’
κῆρα: κήρ — doom, fate of death; fem. acc. sg.
λάβε: λαμβάνω — take, seize; aor. 3 sg., unaugmented (= ἔλαβε); λαβεῖν + gen. ’take hold of’
λήμνοιο: Λῆμνος — Lemnos, island of the northern Aegean; fem. gen. sg., epic -οιο (= Attic -ου), after ἐκ
λίπεν: λείπω — leave, quit; aor. 3 sg., unaugmented (= ἔλιπε)
λαβὼν: λαμβάνω — take, seize; aor. part. masc. nom. sg.: ’having taken’, ’having seized’
λυκάονι: Λυκάων — Lycaon, a son of Priam; masc. dat. sg.
λῆμνον: Λῆμνος — Lemnos, the island; fem. acc. sg., object of εἰσαφίκανε
μ: ἐγώ — I; encl. acc. sg., elided (μ’ = με): ’me’ · also = dat. μοι, elided before a vowel, with a dat. participle: ’to me’ (ἥ μ’ οἴῳ ἔρροντι συνήντετο, συναντάω + dat.) · also = dat. μοι, elided, with a dat. adjective: ’to me’ (μ’ οἴῳ ἀμύνετε ’defend me alone’)
μάλα: μάλα — very, very much, exceedingly; adv.
μέγα: μέγας — great, huge; neut. nom./acc. sg. · also neut. acc. sg. used adverbially: ’greatly’ (μέγα νήπιοι ’greatly foolish’)
μέλαιναν: μέλας — black, dark; fem. acc. sg.
μέλλω: μέλλω — be about to, intend, be likely to; pres. 1 sg. + inf.: ’I am about to, I am set to’
μέν: μέν — on the one hand; truly; particle, often answered by δέ; acute before an enclitic; ἦ μέν ’truly’ in oaths · also asseverative, = μήν ’surely, truly’ (οὐ μέν πως ’surely not in any way’) · also μένω — stay, stand firm; pres. imper. 2 sg., elided (μέν’ = μένε): ’stand!’ (ἠὲ μέν’ ’either stand’)
μένων: μένω — remain, stay; pres. part. masc. nom. sg.: ’staying’
μή: μή — not; the negative of wish, command, fear and condition (where οὐ is the negative of fact) · also ’lest’, with the subj. · also ’lest’ with the opt. (μή … δευοίατο ’lest they lack’) · also ’lest’ with a dual verb in -ετον: ’lest the two … hang back’ · also the negative of an infinitive in an oath: ’never to’ (μή ποτε … ἐπιβήμεναι) · also ’lest’ with a fut. indic., fear: ’lest he be angered’ (μή πως … κεχολώσεται)
μήδετο: μήδομαι — devise, plan, contrive; impf. 3 sg.: ’was devising, planned’
μαίνετο: μαίνομαι — rage, be frenzied; impf. 3 sg. mid. dep., unaugmented (= ἐμαίνετο): ’raged’
μακρὸν: μακρός — long, tall, high; masc. acc. sg., agreeing with Ὄλυμπον · also neut. acc. sg. used adverbially with ἄϋσεν: ’loudly’ · also neut. nom. sg., agreeing with δόρυ: ’long (spear)’ · also masc. acc. sg., agreeing with ὀχῆα: ’long’ (μακρὸν ὀχῆα ’the long bar’)
μεγάλ: μέγας — great, loud; neut. acc. pl. used adverbially, elided (μεγάλ’ = μεγάλα): ’loudly’ · also neut. nom. pl., elided (μεγάλ’ = μεγάλα), adj. agreeing with a noun: ’great (stones)’
μεγαλήτορα: μεγαλήτωρ — great-spirited, great-hearted; adj., masc. acc. sg., agreeing with θυμόν: ’great-hearted’
μεγαλήτορες: μεγαλήτωρ — great-spirited, high in courage; masc. nom. pl., also voc. in address: ’great-spirited (Trojans)!’
μεθίει: μεθίημι — let go, release; impf. 3 sg. act., unaugmented (= Attic ἀφίει): ’let go’
μεμαώς: μέμονα (defective perf., pres. force) — be eager, be minded; perf. part. act. masc. nom. sg., epic (= Attic μεμονώς): ’eager’
μενεαίνων: μενεαίνω — be eager, rage; pres. part. act., masc. nom. sg.: ’eager, furious’
μενοιτιάδαο: Μενοιτιάδης — son of Menoetius, i.e. Patroclus; masc. gen. sg., patronymic, epic -αο (= Attic -ου)
μετὰ: μετά — among, with, after; + dat./acc./gen. · also an adverb, ’among them’, or a preverb in tmesis · also + acc. in μετὰ νῶτα βαλών: ’behind, with the back turned’ · also + acc. of direction: ’to, back to’ (μετὰ νῆας ’to the ships’) · also + dat. of place: ’in’ (μετὰ φρεσί ’in the mind’)
μιν: μιν — him, her, it; epic encl. acc. pron. (= Attic αὐτόν/αὐτήν/αὐτό)
μοί: ἐγώ — I; dat. sg., accented μοί before the enclitic that follows: ’to me, for me’
μοῖρ: μοῖρα — fate, portion, lot; fem. nom. sg., elided (μοῖρ’ = μοῖρα)
μὲν: μέν — on the one hand; particle, often answered by δέ · also asseverative, = μήν ’truly, indeed’: οὐ μὲν δή ’surely not’
νέεσθαι: νέομαι — go, return home; pres. inf., epic uncontracted (= Attic νεῖσθαι)
νηλεὲς: νηλεής — pitiless, ruthless; neut. acc. sg., agreeing with ἦτορ · also neut. acc. sg., agreeing with ἦμαρ: ’pitiless’
νηυσὶν: ναῦς — ship; fem. dat. pl., epic νηυσί(ν)
νώτου: νῶτον — back; neut. gen. sg., after ἀπό: ’from the back’ · also neut. gen. sg., after ὑπέρ: ’over the back’
νῆας: ναῦς — ship; fem. acc. pl., epic νῆας (= Attic ναῦς)
ξάνθου: Ξάνθος — the Xanthus, a river of Lycia; masc. gen. sg. · also Ξάνθος — the river of the Troad, also called Scamander; masc. gen. sg. (Ξάνθου δινήεντος ’of eddying Xanthus’)
ξεῖνός: ξεῖνος — stranger, guest-friend (epic = Attic ξένος); masc. nom. sg., accented before an enclitic
οἱ: οἱ — encl. dat. sg. pron. ’to/for him, her’ · also ὁ, ἡ, τό, masc. nom. pl. ’they’ · also masc. nom. pl. with a noun, article-like: ’the’ (οἱ ἄριστοι ’the best men’) · also enclitic dat. sg. pron. for a thing: ’on it, to it’ (ἐν δέ οἱ ἧλοι ’and on it studs’)
οἳ: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it (in Homer a pronoun); masc. nom. pl., ’they’ · also relative ὅς, masc. nom. pl., ’who’ · also masc. nom. pl. with a noun, article-like: ’the’ (οἳ θάμνοι ’the bushes’) · also masc. nom. pl. in the correlative οἳ μὲν … οἳ δέ: ’some … others’
οἵ: ὅς, ἥ, ὅ — who, which; relative pron., masc. nom. pl. · also demonstrative, with γε: ’they’ (οἵ γ’ ἀθέριζον) · also encl. dat. sg. οἱ, accented before a following enclitic: ’to him’ (δέ οἵ ἐστ’ ’and his … is’)
οἶον: οἶος — alone, only; neut. acc. sg.: ’only, nothing but’ · also masc. acc. sg., ’alone’, agreeing with the object · also neut. nom. sg. (same form), agreeing with δέρμα: ’only’ (οἶον δέρμα ’only the skin’)
οἷον: οἷος — such as, of what sort; masc. acc. sg., correlative of τοῖος (rough breathing; distinct from οἶος ’alone’) · also neut. acc. sg. in an indirect exclamation: ’what (a thing)’ (οἷον ἔειπε ’what he said’) · also neut. acc. sg. · also neut. acc. sg. as an exclamatory adverb: ’how’ (οἷον … θαυμάζομεν ’how we marvel’) · also neut. nom. sg., agreeing with μένος: ’such as (my might) is’ · also masc. acc. sg., agreeing with an unspoken με: ’such as (I was) when’ · also neut. acc. sg., agreeing with ἔρνος, correlative of τοῖον: ’such as (a shoot)’
οἷσι: ὅς, ἥ, ὅ — who, which; relative pron., masc. dat. pl., epic -σι (= Attic οἷς): ’to whom’ · also possessive ὅς, ἥ, ὅν: ’his own, its own’; neut. dat. pl. (οἷσι τέκεσσι ’its own young’) · also possessive ὅς, ἥ, ὅν: masc. dat. pl., ’his own’ (οἷσι πόδεσσι ’on his own feet’)
οὐ: οὐ — not; neg. adv. · also in a question expecting the answer ’yes’ (οὐ γὰρ δὴ … ἐβούλευσας; ’did you not devise …?’)
οὐδ: οὐδέ (elided οὐδ’) — and not, nor, not even
οὐδέ: οὐδέ — and not, nor, not even; neg. conj.
οὐδὲ: οὐδέ — and not, nor, not even; neg. conj. (grave, mid-clause form)
οὐκ: οὐ — not; neg. adv., form before a vowel with smooth breathing (οὐχ before a rough breathing)
οὐχ: οὐ — not; neg. adv., form before a rough breathing (οὐχ) · also in a question expecting ’yes’ (ἦ οὐχ ἅλις ὅττι … ; ’is it not enough that …?’)
οὕς: ὅς, ἥ, ὅ (relative) — who, which; masc. acc. pl., object of ἔπασχον: ’which (struggles)’ · also relative of persons, object of γνοίην: ’whom’ (οὕς κεν ἐῢ γνοίην ’whom I could recognise’) · also relative, object of ἑλόμην: ’which’ (of horses)
πάντα: πᾶς — all, every; neut. acc. pl.: ’all (things)’ · also masc. acc. sg., agreeing with a name: ’all (through the whole of)’ (Αἰγιαλόν τ’ ἀνὰ πάντα) · also neut. acc. pl. adverbially: ’in every respect, in all things’ · also neut. nom. pl., agreeing with ταῦτα: ’all’ (ταῦτα … πάντα ’all these things’) · also masc. acc. sg., agreeing with χρόα: ’all (the flesh)’ · also neut. nom. pl., subject, agreeing with ἄλλα: ’all else’ (ἄλλά τε πάντα) · also neut. acc. pl., agreeing with ἤματα: ’all (days)’ (ἤματα πάντα ’all days’)
πέμψεν: πέμπω — send; aor. 3 sg. act., unaugmented, with ν-movable (= ἔπεμψε): ’sent’
πήδασον: Πήδασος — Pedasus, a Trojan, son of Bucolion; masc. acc. sg. · also Pedasus, a town on the Satnioeis; fem. acc. sg. · also Pedasus, a horse of Achilles, the trace-horse; masc. acc. sg.
πατρόκλοιο: Πάτροκλος — Patroclus, Achilles’ companion; masc. gen. sg., epic -οιο (= Attic -ου)
πατρός: πατήρ — father; masc. gen. sg.: ’(my) father’s’ (πατρός τε μέγα κλέος ’my father’s great glory’); also gen. of comparison after ἀμείνων: ’than his father’
πατρώϊον: πατρώϊος — of one’s father, ancestral; neut. acc. sg.
περ: περ — even, though; enclitic particle, concessive or intensive; εἴ περ ’even if’
περὶ: περί — around; + gen.: ’beyond, above’, or adv. ’exceedingly’ · also preverb in tmesis ’all round’ · also adv. in tmesis with εἰμί: ’surpass’ (περὶ … ἐστέ) · also + dat. of place: ’around’ (περὶ δουρί ’around the spear’) · also with ἀμφί, both before an accusative, ’round about’ (ἀμφὶ περὶ κρήνην ’round about a spring’) · also prep. + acc. of place: ’around’ (περὶ Δωδώνην ’around Dodona’) · also + gen., ’about, for the sake of’ (μαχήσονται περὶ σεῖο ’will fight about you’) · also adv. ’around, about’ (περὶ … ἦσαν ’were around’) · also adv., ’round about, on every side’ (περὶ κτείνοντο ’were killed all around’) · also adv. ’beyond others’ with the dat. of respect: ’by far’ (περὶ ἔγχει … φέρτατος ’best by far with the spear’) · also prep. + dat., of concern: ’for, over’ (περὶ ξανθῷ Μενελάῳ ’for fair-haired Menelaus’) · also prep. + acc. of the thing contended for: ’over’ (περὶ τεύχε’ ’over the armour’) · also + gen. with λείπομαι: ’left over from’ (πολέμοιο περὶ … λίπωνται ’are left over from the war’)
πλῆτο: πελάζω — bring near; mid./pass. draw near, come to; aor. mid. 3 sg., epic, unaugmented: ’was brought to’ (+ dat.) · also πίμπλημι — fill; aor. mid./pass. 3 sg., unaugmented, epic: ’was filled’ (+ gen.)
ποδάρκης: ποδάρκης — swift-footed; masc. nom. sg., epithet of Achilles · also Ποδάρκης — Podarces, son of Iphiclus, leader of the men of Phylace; masc. nom. sg., proper name
ποινὴν: ποινή — requital, compensation, blood-price; fem. acc. sg., in apposition: ’as requital’ · also fem. acc. sg., direct object of a verb of accepting: ’requital’
πολέας: πολύς — much, many; masc./fem. acc. pl., epic πολέας (= Attic πολλούς)
πολιῆς: πολιός — grey (of the sea); fem. gen. sg., Ionic -ῆς (= Attic -ᾶς)
πολλὰ: πολύς — much, many; neut. acc. pl.; also adverbial, ’much, earnestly’ · also neut. nom. pl., agreeing with ἔργα: ’many (works)’
πολλὰς: πολύς — much, many; fem. acc. pl., accent grave mid-clause
πολύδωρον: Πολύδωρος — Polydorus, youngest son of Priam; masc. acc. sg.
ποτ: ποτέ — once, at some time, ever; enclitic adv., elided (ποτ’ = ποτέ)
ποταμοῖο: ποταμός — river; masc. gen. sg., epic -οιο (= Attic -ου)
που: που — somewhere, anywhere; perhaps, I suppose; enclitic adv.
πρίαμος: Πρίαμος — Priam, king of Troy; masc. nom. sg.
πριάμοιο: Πρίαμος — Priam, king of Troy; masc. gen. sg., epic -οιο (= Attic -ου)
προσηύδα: προσαυδάω — speak to, address; impf. 3 sg.
προχέοντο: προχέω — pour forth; mid./pass. stream forth; impf. 3 pl. mid./pass., unaugmented (= προεχέοντο): ’poured forth’
πρόσθε: πρόσθε — before, in front; adv. · also prep. + gen.: ’in front of’
πρώτοισι: πρῶτος — first, foremost; masc. dat. pl., epic -οισι (= Attic -οις): ’the foremost’
πρὸς: πρός — towards, to; prep. + acc. · also + gen.: ’from, at the hands of’ (πρὸς Τρώων ’from the Trojans’) · also + gen. of witnesses: ’before, in the sight of’ (πρὸς θεῶν ’before the gods’) · also preverb in tmesis, apart from its verb (πρὸς … ἔειπεν ’addressed’) · also adv., ’besides’ (πρὸς δ’ … ῥῆξε ’and besides … broke’) · also prep. + dat.: ’on, against’ (πρὸς χρυσῇ περόνῃ ’on a golden brooch’) · also + gen. of direction: ’toward, on the side of’ (πρὸς ἁλός ’toward the sea’) · also in πρὸς ἰθύ ’straight toward’, with ἰθύ adverbial · also + acc., ’against’ (πρὸς δαίμονα ’against a divinity’)
πτερόεντα: πτερόεις — winged (πτερόν ’feather, wing’); neut. acc. pl.: ’winged (words)’ · also masc. acc. sg., of an arrow: ’winged’
πόντος: πόντος — sea, open sea; masc. nom. sg.
πόποι: πόποι — in ὦ πόποι, exclamation of surprise or displeasure: ’ah! alas!’; origin unknown
πόρον: πόρος — ford, crossing-place; masc. acc. sg. · also πόρον — gave, granted; defective aor. (suppletive of δίδωμι), 1 sg. or 3 pl. act.

σ: σύ — you (sg.); encl. acc. sg., elided (σ’ = σε): ’you’ · also σός, σή, σόν — your; neut. acc. pl., elided (σ’ = σά), agreeing with ἔργα: ’your’ (τὰ σ’ αὐτῆς ἔργα ’your own tasks’)
σοὶ: σύ — you (sg.); dat. sg.: ’to, for you’
στόνος: στόνος — groaning, moaning; masc. nom. sg.
σχεδὸν: σχεδόν — near, close by; adv. (also + gen./dat.)
σὺ: σύ — you (sg.); nom. sg. (grave, mid-clause form)
σῇσι: σός — your (sg.); fem. dat. pl., epic -ῃσι (= Attic -αῖς)
τάμνε: τέμνω — cut; impf. 3 sg. act., epic, unaugmented (= Attic ἔτεμνε): ’was cutting’
τέκετο: τίκτω — beget, bear; aor. 3 sg. mid., epic, unaugmented (= ἐτέκετο): ’begot’, said of a father · also ’bore’, said of a mother
ταὶ: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it; that (in Homer a pronoun); fem. nom. pl., epic (= Attic αἱ): ’they, those two’
τε: τε — and, both...and; enclitic connective; also ’epic τε’ marking a standing general truth in relative clauses
τεῖρε: τείρω — wear down, distress, oppress; impf. 3 sg., unaugmented (= ἔτειρε)

τοι: σύ — you (sg.); encl. dat. sg.: ’to/for you’ · also τοι, the affirming particle: ’you know, indeed’ (esp. in ἦ τοι, οὔ τοι); the two are not always easy to keep apart
τοὺς: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it; that (in Homer a pronoun; later the article); masc. acc. pl. ’them’ · also relative, masc. acc. pl.: ’whom’ · also masc. acc. pl. with a noun, article-like: ’the’ (τοὺς ἄλλους ’the others’) · also masc. acc. pl. in the correlative τοὺς μέν … τοὺς δέ: ’some … others’
τοῦ: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it (in Homer a pronoun); masc. gen. sg., ’of him, him’ · also relative, ’whose’ · also with a noun, ’that’ (τοῦ βασιλῆος ’that king’) · also neut. gen. sg., ’of it’, after ἐκ: ’out of it’ (the chariot-board) · also neut. gen. sg. demonstrative, ’of this, that’, as the object of a verb taking the genitive (τοῦ δ’ ἐπιλήσονται ’but that they will forget’) · also neut. gen. sg. in ἐκ τοῦ, temporal: ’from that time’ · also masc. gen. sg., ’the other’, after πρό (πρὸ ὃ τοῦ ’before the other’) · also masc. gen. sg. standing for a masculine thing: ’of it, its’ (τοῦ δέκα οἶμοι ’ten bands of it’) · also masc. gen. sg., gen. of comparison: ’than he, than him’ (after ἀμείνων) · also masc. gen. sg., of separation, with ἀπέσσεσθαι: ’from it, from him’ · also neut. gen. sg. standing for a thing, of separation after ἀπάνευθε: ’away from it’
τρὶς: τρίς — three times, thrice; numeral adv.
τρῶες: Τρῶες — the Trojans; masc. nom. pl. · also masc. voc. pl., in address: ’Trojans!’
τόδ: ὅδε — this (near the speaker); neut. acc. sg., elided (τόδ’ = τόδε) · also neut. nom. sg., agreeing with a noun: ’this’ (τόδ’ αἰνὸν ἄχος ’this dread grief’)
τόν: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it; that (in Homer a pronoun; later the article); masc. acc. sg. ’him’, with γε ’him at least’ · also relative, ’whom, which’ (τόν ῥ’ … ἧκε ’which he sent’) · also masc. acc. sg. with a noun, article-like: ’that (lord)’
τόσσα: τόσος — so much, so many; epic τόσσος (doubled σ), neut. acc. pl. · also neut. nom. pl., agreeing with πυρά: ’so many’ (τόσσα … πυρά ’so many fires’)
τότε: τότε — then, at that time; adv.
τύπτε: τύπτω — strike, beat; impf. 3 sg., unaugmented (= ἔτυπτε): ’kept beating’
τὰ: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it; that (in Homer a pronoun; later the article); neut. nom./acc. pl. · τὰ πρῶτα ’at first’ · also relative ὅς, ἥ, ὅ, neut. acc. pl.: ’which’ · also neut. acc. pl. with a noun, article-like: ’the’ (τὰ σ’ αὐτῆς ἔργα ’your own tasks’)
τὸ: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it; that (in Homer a pronoun; later the article); neut. nom./acc. sg., ’this, that’ · also relative, neut. nom. sg.: ’which’ (σκῆπτρον, τὸ … οὔ ποτε φύλλα φύσει) · also neut. acc. sg. with a noun, article-like: ’the, that’ (τὸ Πελασγικὸν Ἄργος ’the Pelasgian Argos’) · also neut. acc. sg. adverbial: ’on that account, therefore’ (τὸ καὶ κλαίουσα τέτηκα ’and so I waste away weeping’) · also τὸ πρῶτον, adverbial: ’at first’ (ὡς τὸ πρῶτον ’as at first’) · also τὸ πρίν, adverbial: ’before, formerly’ · also τὸ τέταρτον, adverbial: ’for the fourth time’ · also τὸ πάρος, adverbial: ’as before’ · also neut. nom. sg. with a noun, article-like: ’the’ (τὸ δ’ ἐμὸν κῆρ ’and my heart’) · also relative, neut. acc. sg.: ’which’ (τὸ ποιήσαντο ’which they made’)
τὸν: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it (in Homer a pronoun; later the article); masc. acc. sg., ’him’; with a noun, ’that’ · also relative, ’whom’ · also masc. acc. sg. standing for a masculine thing: ’it’ (τὸν δῶκε ’gave it’) · also masc. acc. sg., in the correlative τὸν μέν … τὸν δέ: ’the one … the other’ · also masc. acc. sg. as antecedent of a relative: ’the man (who)’ (τὸν μὲν … ὅς κε ’the man who’)
τῆς: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it; that (in Homer a pronoun); fem. gen. sg. · also fem. gen. sg. with the force of a relative: ’of which’ · also fem. gen. sg. ’for her’, gen. of cause after ἀχέων (τῆς … ἀχέων ’grieving for her’) · also fem. gen. sg., of the person heard after ἔκλυεν: ’her’ · also fem. gen. sg. with a noun, demonstrative: ’that’ (φιλότητος … τῆς ’that friendship’)
τῇ: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it; fem. dat. sg. · with an ordinal, ’on the (day)’: τῇ δεκάτῃ ’on the tenth’ · also adverbial, ’by that way, there’ · also fem. dat. sg. as relative adverb: ’by which way’ (τῇ … ἔμελλε διεξίμεναι ’by which he was about to go out’) · also fem. dat. sg. with a noun, article-like: ’the, my’ (τῇ ἐμῇ κλισίῃ ’my hut’) · also relative adverb: ’where’ (τῇ ῥα μάλιστα ’where especially’) · also fem. dat. sg. with the postpositive ὕπο: ’beneath it’ (τῇ ὕπο) · also relative, fem. dat. sg., of means: ’with which’ (τῇ … ἐπισσείων ’shaking which’) · also fem. dat. sg. demonstrative, with ἐνί: ’by it’ (of a shield-rim, τῇ … ἐνὶ βλαφθεὶς ’hindered by it’) · also fem. dat. sg. of possession, ’she has’ (τῇ … ἁπαλοὶ πόδες ’her feet are tender’)
τῶν: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it; that (in Homer a pronoun; later the article); gen. pl. ’of these, of them, of which’ · also gen. pl. with a noun, article-like: ’the’ (τῶν ἄλλων Τρώων ’the other Trojans’)
τῷ: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it (in Homer a pronoun); masc./neut. dat. sg., ’to him’ · also adverbial, ’therefore’ · also neut., ’on it’ (τῷ … ἐρεισάμενος ’leaning on it’) · also with a noun, ’that, the’ (ἤματι τῷ ’on that day’; τῷ δεκάτῳ ’in the tenth’) · also instrumental, ’with it’ (τῷ … τύψε ’struck with it’) · also relative, instrumental: ’with which’ · also causal/instrumental, ’by it’ (τῷ τείρετο ’was worn by it’) · also with ἅμα, of company: ’with him’ (τῷ … ἅμ’ ’along with him’) · also neut. dat. sg., ’in it’ (ἐν τῷ … κύκησε ’in it mixed’, of a cup) · also masc. dat. sg. with a participle: ’upon him (as he drew)’ (ἐπὶ τῷ ἐρύοντι) · also neut. dat. sg., demonstrative before a relative: ’that’ (τῷ ἴκελον οἷον ’like that which’) · also relative, masc. dat. sg.: ’at whom’ (τῷ ἐφέηκα ’at whom I let fly’)
υἷι: υἱός — son; masc. dat. sg., epic υἷι (= Attic υἱεῖ)
φάσγανον: φάσγανον — sword; neut. acc. sg. · also neut. nom. sg., subject: ’sword’ (φάσγανον ἐρραίσθη ’the sword shattered’)
φίλοισιν: φίλος — dear, one’s own; masc./neut. dat. pl., epic -οισιν (= Attic -οις); also as a noun: ’friends’
φίλων: φίλος — dear, one’s own; masc. gen. pl. · also attributive with ἑτάρων: ’dear (companions)’ · also substantive, ’loved ones’, in a phrase with πατρίδος αἴης (τῆλε φίλων ’far from loved ones’)

φευγέμεναι: φεύγω — flee; pres. inf., epic -έμεναι (= Attic φεύγειν), of purpose: ’to flee’
φεύγοντ: φεύγω — flee, escape; pres. part. act. masc. acc. sg., elided (φεύγοντ’ = φεύγοντα): ’fleeing’
φεύγοντες: φεύγω — flee; pres. part. act. masc. nom. pl.: ’fleeing’
φεύγοντι: φεύγω — flee; pres. part. masc. dat. sg.: ’to one fleeing, as you flee’
φεύξεσθαι: φεύγω — flee, escape; fut. inf. mid., in indirect statement after ἔφαν: ’that they would flee’
φιλοπτολέμοισιν: φιλοπτόλεμος — war-loving; masc. dat. pl., epic -οισιν (= Attic -οις)
φοβέοντο: φοβέω — frighten; mid./pass. flee in terror; impf. 3 pl. mid., uncontracted and unaugmented (= Attic ἐφοβοῦντο): ’were fleeing in panic’
φορέεσκον: φορέω — carry, bear; impf. 3 pl., iterative -εσκ- (epic), uncontracted, unaugmented: ’used to carry’
φρεσὶ: φρήν — mind, heart, wits; fem. dat. pl.
φρεσὶν: φρήν — mind, heart, wits (lit. midriff); fem. dat. pl.
φυσίζοος: φυσίζοος — life-giving, grain-giving; adj., fem. nom. sg., epithet of the earth
φωνήσας: φωνέω — utter, raise one’s voice; aor. part. masc. nom. sg.: ’having raised his voice’
χαμαὶ: χαμαί — on the ground, to the ground; adv.
χροὸς: χρώς — skin, flesh; masc. gen. sg., epic χροός (= Attic χρωτός)
ἀΐδαο: Ἀΐδης — Hades, god and realm of the dead; masc. gen. sg., epic -αο (= Attic Ἅιδου)
ἀέκοντας: ἀέκων — unwilling; masc. acc. pl., epic (= Attic ἄκων), agreeing with ἵππους · also masc. acc. pl., agreeing with ἑταίρους: ’unwilling’
ἀεικὴς: ἀεικής — unseemly, shameful, ghastly; adj. of two endings, masc. nom. sg., agreeing with στόνος
ἀθάνατος: ἀθάνατος — immortal, deathless; adj., masc. nom. sg.
ἀκάματον: ἀκάματος — untiring, unwearied; neut. acc. sg., of fire: ’unflagging’
ἀκαχμένον: ἀκαχμένος — sharpened, of obscure formation; perf. pass. part. masc./neut. acc. sg.
ἀκτὴν: ἀκτή — grain, ground corn (Δημήτερος ἀκτή ’Demeter’s grain’); fem. acc. sg. · also ἀκτή — headland, shore; fem. acc. sg., goal of motion: ’onto the shore’
ἀλαλητῷ: ἀλαλητός — war-cry, shout; masc. dat. sg., of manner: ’with a shout’
ἀλλ: ἀλλά (elided ἀλλ’) — but; well then · also ’except’: ’but only’ (ἀλλ’ οἶοι ’except us two’)
ἀλωῆς: ἀλωή — orchard, vineyard, cultivated plot; fem. gen. sg.
ἀλωῇ: ἀλωή — plot, orchard, vineyard; threshing-floor (= ἅλως); fem. dat. sg.

ἀνδρομέοιο: ἀνδρόμεος — of a man, human; adj., masc. gen. sg., epic -οιο (= Attic -ου), agreeing with a noun
ἀντί: ἀντίος — facing, opposite; neut. acc. pl. ἀντία used as adv. + gen., elided (ἀντί’ = ἀντία): ’opposite, facing’ · also ἀντί prep. + gen. — in place of, worth as much as: ’worth as much as many peoples’
ἀντίθεον: ἀντίθεος — godlike, a match for a god; masc. acc. sg.

ἀτυζόμενοι: ἀτύζομαι — be bewildered, panic; pres. part. mid. masc. nom. pl.: ’in panic’
ἀτὰρ: ἀτάρ — but, and; epic conj. (by-form of αὐτάρ)
ἀχαιοὶ: Ἀχαιοί — the Achaeans, the Greeks; masc. nom. pl.

ἄρα: ἄρα — so, then, as it turned out; inferential particle
ἄτερ: ἄτερ — apart from, without; prep. + gen.
ἐδάμνα: δαμνάω (by-form of δαμάζω) — overpower, subdue; impf. 3 sg. act., augmented: ’was overcoming’
ἐθέλοντα: ἐθέλω — wish, be willing; pres. part. masc. acc. sg.: ’(me) though I wish’ · also masc. acc. sg. agreeing with a relative: ’wishing (to hang back)’ · also with οὐκ: ’unwilling’ (οὐκ ἐθέλοντα ’not wishing, unwilling’)
ἐκ: ἐκ (ἐξ before a vowel) — out of, from; + gen. · also as adverb or preverb in tmesis, no case expressed: ’out’ (ἐκ δ’ ἔβαν ’and out they stepped’) · also in παρ’ ἐκ (= παρέκ) + acc.: ’beyond’ (παρ’ ἐκ νόον ’beyond reason’)
ἐλεύσεται: ἔρχομαι (fut. ἐλεύσομαι) — come, go; fut. 3 sg. mid.
ἐλθὼν: ἔρχομαι — go, come; aor. part. act. masc. nom. sg.: ’having come’
ἐλύσατο: λύω — loose, unfasten; aor. 3 sg. mid.: ’unfastened (for herself)’
ἐμοὶ: ἐγώ — I; dat. sg.: ’to, for me’ · also dat. of possession: ’mine is, I have’ (ἐμοὶ δ’ ὄνομα ’my name is’) · also dat. governed by ὑπό: ’under me’ (ὑπ’ ἐμοὶ δμηθέντα ’subdued under me’)
ἐν: ἐν — in, on, among; + dat.; also used as an adverb, ’in it, there’ · also as preverb in tmesis, standing apart from its verb (ἐν … βάλῃ = ἐμβάλῃ ’cast in’; ἐν … χεῦον = ἔγχεον ’pour in’)
ἐνηέα: ἐνηής — kindly, gentle; masc. acc. sg., epic (= Attic ἐνηῆ)
ἐνθάδ: ἐνθάδε (elided ἐνθάδ’) — in this place, to this place; adv.
ἐνόησε: νοέω — perceive, notice, think; aor. 3 sg. act., augmented: ’noticed’
ἐνὶ: ἐν (epic ἐνί) — in, on, among; + dat. · also adverb or preverb, no case: ’therein’ (ἔνθ’ ἐνὶ πέπλοι ... βεβλήατο ’therein coverlets were laid’) · also + gen., of a person’s house: ’in the house of’ (ἐνὶ Κίρκης ’in Circe’s house’)
ἐξαίφνης: ἐξαίφνης — suddenly, all at once; adv.
ἐπ: ἐπί (elided ἐπ’) — on, upon, over, at; + dat./acc./gen. · also + acc., ’to, towards’ (βῆ δ’ ἐπ’ Ἀτρεΐδην ’went to the son of Atreus’) · also + dat., ’to’ (πέμψαι ἐπ’ Ἀτρεΐδῃ ’to send to’) · also preverb in tmesis (ἐπ’ … θήσειν ’to lay upon’) · also + acc. of time, ’until, at’ (ἐπ’ ἠέλιον δῦναι ’until the sun sets’) · also + dat., ’against’ (ἐπ’ ἀλλήλοισιν ἰόντες ’coming against one another’) · also + gen., ’toward’ (ἐπ’ ὠκεανοῖο ῥοάων ’toward the streams of Oceanus’) · also adv., ’next, after them’ (τοῖσι δ’ ἐπ’ Ἰδομενεύς ’and after them Idomeneus’) · also + dat. of place, ’close by, hard by’ (ἐπ’ αὐτῷ τάφρον ὄρυξαν ’dug a ditch close by it’) · also + dat. of time, ’within, in’ (ἐπ’ ἤματι ’in a single day’) · also + a φιν-form of place: ’on the (left) side’ (ἐπ’ ἀριστερόφιν ’on the left’) · also + gen., ’on’ (ἐπ’ εὐνάων ’on anchor-stones’)
ἐπέλασσέ: ἐπελάζω — bring near, bring together; aor. 3 sg. act., epic -σσ- (= Attic ἐπέλασε), accented before γε
ἐπεί: ἐπεί — after, since, when; conj. · with κε + subj.: ’whenever, once’
ἐπιμὶξ: ἐπιμίξ — in confusion, mixed together; adv. (cf. μίγνυμι)
ἐπιστροφάδην: ἐπιστροφάδην — turning this way and that, right and left; adv. (from ἐπιστρέφω)
ἐπόρουσε: ἐπορούω — rush upon, spring upon; aor. 3 sg. act., unaugmented (= ἐπώρουσε)
ἐπὶ: ἐπί — on, upon, to, against; + dat./acc./gen.; also a preverb in tmesis (ἐπὶ … ἔτελλε = ἐπέτελλε) · also + dat., ’in aid of, on behalf of’ (ἐπὶ Τρώεσσιν ἀρῆξαι ’to help the Trojans’) · also + acc. of duration, ’for’ (ἐπὶ χρόνον ’for a time’) · also + acc. of extent, ’over, along’ (ἐπὶ νῶτον ’along the back’) · also + acc. of the thing aimed at, ’for’ (ἐπὶ τεύχεα ’for the armour’) · also + gen., ’toward’ (μελαινάων ἐπὶ νηῶν ’toward the black ships’) · also + gen. of time, ’in the time of’ (ἐπὶ προτέρων ἀνθρώπων ’in the time of earlier men’) · also adv., ’next, after’ (ἐπὶ δὲ πλήξιππον Ὀρέστην ’and next Orestes’) · also adv., ’besides, in addition’ (ἐπὶ δὲ … ὅρκον ὀμοῦμαι ’besides, I shall swear an oath’) · also adv., ’on it, upon it’ (ἐπὶ … ζυγὸν ἦεν ’there was a yoke upon it’) · also + dat. of time: ’for, during’ (ἐπὶ νυκτί ’for the night’) · also + dat., ’over, for’ (ἐπὶ κτεάτεσσι ’over possessions’) · also + gen., ’for’ (ἐπὶ δώρων ’for the gifts’; force uncertain) · also + dat. of place: ’at’ (ἐπὶ τάφρῳ ’at the ditch’) · also ἐπὶ ἶσα, adverbial: ’equally, evenly’ · also + a φιν-form of place: ’on the (right) side’ (ἐπὶ δεξιόφιν ’on the right’) · also + dat. of respect: ’in’ (ἐπὶ φρεσὶ … κέκασται ’excels in wits’)
ἐρέω: ἐρέω — say, tell, declare; fut. 1 sg. (epic fut. of εἶπον, = Attic ἐρῶ); in tmesis with ἐκ, ἐξερέω ’speak out plainly’
ἐρινεὸν: ἐρινεός — wild fig-tree; masc. acc. sg., after παρά: ’beside the wild fig tree’
ἐρυθαίνετο: ἐρυθαίνω — make red; pass. grow red; impf. 3 sg. pass. (the ἐ- belongs to the stem): ’was growing red’
ἐρυκέμεν: ἐρύκω — hold back, keep off; pres. inf. act., epic -έμεν (= Attic ἐρύκειν): ’to hold back’
ἐρύκει: ἐρύκω — hold back, restrain, keep off; pres. 3 sg.
ἐρύξει: ἐρύκω — hold back, check, restrain; fut. 3 sg. act.: ’will check’
ἐς: εἰς (epic ἐς) — into, to; + acc. · also as a preverb in tmesis, standing apart from its verb with no case expressed (ἐς … ἦλθον = εἰσῆλθον ’came in’) · also + acc. of time: ’until’ (ἐς ἠέλιον καταδύντα ’until sunset’) · also + acc. of purpose: ’for’ (ἐς βρωτύν ’for food’)
ἐϋκτιμένην: ἐΰκτίμενος — well-built, well-founded; fem. acc. sg., epic ἐϋ- (= εὖ); said of a town
ἐϋκτιμένῃ: ἐΰκτιμένος — well-built, well-founded; adj., fem. dat. sg., epic ἐϋ- (= Attic εὐ-), of a town
ἐϋρρεῖος: ἐϋρρεής — fair-flowing; masc. gen. sg. (= Attic εὐρρεοῦς), agreeing with ποταμοῖο
ἐϋτμήτοισιν: ἐΰτμητος — well-cut; masc. dat. pl., epic ἐϋ- and -οισιν (= Attic εὔτμητος, -οις), agreeing with ἱμᾶσι: ’well-cut (straps)’
ἑλὼν: αἱρέω — take, seize; aor. part. act. masc. nom. sg.: ’having taken’
ἑτέρῃ: ἕτερος — the other (of two), one; fem. dat. sg., agreeing with χειρί: ’in one hand’
ἑταίροισιν: ἑταῖρος — companion, comrade; masc. dat. pl., epic -οισιν (= -οις)
ἑταῖρον: ἑταῖρος — companion, comrade; masc. acc. sg.
ἔθηκε: τίθημι — put, place, cause, bring about; aor. 3 sg., augmented (root θη-/θε-, consonant-initial; unaugmented θῆκε): ’set, caused’ (ἔριν ἔθηκε ’set strife’)
ἔμβαλεν: ἐμβάλλω — throw in, put in; aor. 3 sg. act., augmented: ’threw in’
ἔμελλε: μέλλω — be about to, be destined to (+ inf.); impf. 3 sg.: ’was about to’
ἔνθ: ἔνθα (elided ἔνθ’) — there, then; adverb of place or time · also relative adv., ’where’ (ἔνθ’ ἄρα τε φρένες ἔρχαται ’where the midriff is shut’)
ἔνθα: ἔνθα — there, then; adverb of place or time · also relative, ’where’ (ἔνθα πάρος κοιμᾶθ’ ’where he used to sleep’) · also ἔνθα καὶ ἔνθα ’hither and thither, this way and that’
ἔνθεν: ἔνθεν — from there, thence; adv. of place, correlative of ὅθεν
ἔπεα: ἔπος — word, speech; neut. nom./acc. pl., epic uncontracted (= Attic ἔπη)
ἔπεσον: πίπτω — fall; aor. 3 pl. (also 1 sg.), augmented (unaugmented πέσον); with σύν in tmesis, σὺν … ἔπεσον = συνέπεσον ’fell together, clashed’
ἔπεφνεν: θείνω — strike, slay; aor. 3 sg., ν-movable; ἔπεφνον is a reduplicated aorist (stem πε-φν-) used as aorist of θείνω, with no present in use: ’slew’
ἔργα: ἔργον — deed, work; neut. nom./acc. pl. · also ’tilled land, farmland’ (ἔργα νέμοντο ’inhabited the farmlands’)
ἔσθορε: εἰσθρῴσκω — leap in; aor. 3 sg., epic ἔσθορε (= Attic εἰσέθορε): ’leapt in’
ἔσσεται: εἰμί — be; fut. 3 sg., epic doubled σ (= Attic ἔσται)
ἔστη: ἵστημι — set, stand; aor. 3 sg. intrans.: ’stood, took his stand’
ἔσχε: ἔχω — have, hold, hold up; aor. 3 sg.: ’held’
ἔχε: ἔχω — have, hold; impf. 3 sg., unaugmented (= Attic εἶχε) · also pres. imper. 2 sg.: ’hold, keep’
ἔχεν: ἔχω — have, hold; impf. 3 sg., unaugmented (= εἶχεν): ’held’ · also of a feeling, ’seized, gripped’ (θάμβος … ἔχεν ’wonder held (them)’)
ἔχων: ἔχω — have, hold; pres. part. masc. nom. sg.: ’holding’
ἕκτωρ: Ἕκτωρ — Hector, son of Priam; masc. nom. sg.
ἠέρα: ἀήρ — mist, thick air; masc. acc. sg., epic ἠέρα (= Attic ἀέρα)
ἠΰτε: ἠΰτε — like as, even as; epic particle introducing a comparison
ἠδὲ: ἠδέ — and; epic conj. (τε … ἠδέ ’both … and’)
ἠερέθονται: ἠερέθομαι — hover, dangle, sway in the air; pres. 3 pl. mid./pass.: ’dangle’ · also ’flutter, be unsteady’ (of wits): ’are fluttering’
ἠετίων: Ἠετίων — Eëtion, king of Thebe, father of Andromache; masc. nom. sg.
ἠὼς: Ἠώς — Dawn, the goddess; fem. nom. sg. · also ἠώς — morning, dawn (the time of day, not the goddess); fem. nom. sg.: ’it was morning’ (ἠὼς ἦν)
ἡμετέροιο: ἡμέτερος — our; masc. gen. sg., epic -οιο (= Attic -ου)
ἢ: ἤ — or; disjunctive conj.; ἢ … ἤ ’either … or’ · also ’than’ after a comparative · also introducing the first alternative of an indirect question: ’whether’ (ἢ ἐτεὸν … ἦε ’whether truly … or’) · also after πρίν, ’before’ (πρίν γ’ ἢ ’before …’) · also in τί ἢ δέ, a form of τίη δέ: ’why then’ · also ’than, except’ after ἄλλος (ἄλλῳ γ’ ἢ Ἀχιλῆϊ ’than Achilles’) · also in τί ἢ ἐμέ, a form of τίη: ’why’ (τί ἢ ἐμὲ ταῦτα διεξερέεσθε ’why do you ask me these things’) · also ἢ = ἦ, ’truly, surely’ (ἐπεὶ ἢ πολὺ φέρτεροί ’for they are truly far better’)
ἤθελε: ἐθέλω — wish, be willing, want; impf. 3 sg.
ἤλυθε: ἔρχομαι — come, go; aor. 3 sg., epic by-form (= ἦλθε): ’he came’
ἤματα: ἦμαρ — day; neut. acc. pl., acc. of time: ’all the days, every day’
ἤματι: ἦμαρ — day; neut. dat. sg., epic ἤματι
ἤτοι: ἤτοι (also printed ἦ τοι) — truly, surely; affirming particle, often barely translatable at the head of a formula
ἥ: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it (in Homer a pronoun); fem. nom. sg., accented ἥ before γε: ’she’ · also fem. nom. sg. with a noun, article-like: ’the’ (ἥ τε κόμη ’and the hair’) · also relative ὅς, ἥ, ὅ, fem. nom. sg., ’which’ (ἥ τε … πέληται ’which shall be’) · also fem. nom. sg. pronoun, accented ἥ before the enclitic οἱ: ’she’ · also relative, fem. nom. sg., accented before the enclitic οἱ: ’who’ (ἥ οἱ … ἰοῦσα ’who, going before him’)
ἥδε: ὅδε, ἥδε, τόδε — this, this here; demonstrative pron., fem. nom. sg.
ἥρη: Ἥρη (Ionic/epic by-form of Ἥρα) — Hera, wife of Zeus; fem. nom. sg. · also voc. sg. (same form) in address: ’Hera!’
ἦ: ἦ — truly, surely; affirming particle; ἦ μέν in oaths · also an interrogative particle · also ἠμί — say; impf. 3 sg. ἦ ’he said’, in ἦ καί, ἦ ῥα · also ἦ = ἤ, ’or’ (εἰ … ἦ ’whether … or’) · also ἦ … ἦ ’either … or’
ἦγε: ἄγω — lead, bring; impf. 3 sg., augmented: ’led, brought’
ἦμαρ: ἦμαρ — day (epic for ἡμέρα); neut. nom./acc. sg.
ἱεμένη: ἵημι — send, hurl; mid. ἵεμαι press on, be eager; pres. part. mid. fem. nom. sg.: ’pressing forward’
ἱμᾶσι: ἱμάς — strap, thong; masc. dat. pl., of means: ’with straps’
ἴαχον: ἰάχω — cry out, shout; impf. 3 pl., epic: ’they shouted’
ἴδωμαι: ὁράω (aor. stem ἰδ-) — see; aor. subj. 1 sg. mid., with future force: ’shall I see’ · also aor. subj. 1 sg. mid. in a purpose clause after ὄφρα: ’so that I may see’ · also aor. subj. 1 sg. mid. after πρίν γε: ’before I see’
ἴλιον: Ἴλιος — Ilios, Troy; fem. acc. sg.
ἵκετο: ἱκνέομαι — come to, reach, befall; aor. 3 sg., unaugmented, + acc.
ἵν: ἵνα — where; relative adv. of place, elided (ἵν’ = ἵνα; = Attic οὗ) · also conj. ’so that’
ἶσος: ἴσος — equal, like (+ dat.); masc. nom. sg., epic ἶσος
ἷξον: ἵκω — come, arrive, reach; aor. 3 pl.: ’they came’ (+ acc. of place reached, with or without a preposition)
ὀΐω: ὀΐομαι — think, suppose; pres. 1 sg. (act. form ὀΐω, epic; = Attic οἴομαι): ’I think’
ὀξέϊ: ὀξύς — sharp, keen; masc./neut. dat. sg., epic ὀξέϊ (= Attic ὀξεῖ)
ὀπίσσω: ὀπίσσω — behind, backward, afterwards; adv. (= ὀπίσω)
ὀφθαλμοῖσιν: ὀφθαλμός — eye; masc. dat. pl., epic -οισι(ν)
ὀχθήσας: ὀχθέω — be vexed, be troubled; aor. part. masc. nom. sg.: ’vexed, troubled’
ὁμῶς: ὁμῶς — alike, in like manner, equally; adv.
ὁρῶμαι: ὁράω — see; pres. 1 sg. mid. with active sense (epic): ’I behold’
ὃ: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he (in Homer a pronoun); masc. nom. sg., printed with a grave accent in some editions · also relative ὅς, ἥ, ὅ, neut. nom./acc. sg., ’which’ · also neut. nom. sg. demonstrative: ’this’ (ὃ δέ τοι … ὅρκος ’and this shall be your oath’) · also relative ὅς, ἥ, ὅ, masc. nom. sg.: ’who’ (ὃ σφῶϊ προΐει ’who sent you’) · also masc. nom. sg. in the correlative ὃ μὲν … ὃ δέ: ’the one … the other’ · also masc. nom. sg. with a noun, article-like: ’the’ (ὃ πάϊς ’the child’) · also masc. nom. sg., ’the one’ set against a genitive ’the other’ (πρὸ ὃ τοῦ ’before the other’)
ὃν: ὅς, ἥ, ὅν (possessive) — his own, her own; masc./neut. acc. sg. · also relative ὅς, ἥ, ὅν: whom, which (masc. acc. sg.)
ὃς: ὅς, ἥ, ὅν (relative) — who, which; masc. nom. sg. · also possessive ὅς, ἥ, ὅν: his own, her own (masc. nom. sg.) · also plain demonstrative, ’he’ (ὃς γὰρ δεύτατος ἦλθεν), not a relative
ὄρμενον: Ὄρμενος — Ormenus, a Trojan; masc. acc. sg., proper name · also ὄρνυμι — rouse; mid. rise, spring up; aor. part. mid., epic ὄρμενος (= Attic ὀρόμενος); neut. nom. sg., agreeing with πῦρ: ’springing up’
ὄρνυτ: ὄρνυμι — rouse, stir up; mid. rise, start up; impf. 3 sg. mid., unaugmented and elided (ὄρνυτ’ = ὄρνυτο) · also pres. imper. 2 pl. act., elided (ὄρνυτ’ = ὄρνυτε), + acc.: ’raise, rouse’
ὄφρα: ὄφρα — so that, in order that (+ subj.) · also temporal, ’until, while’ · also + opt. in a purpose clause after a past tense: ’so that … might’ (ὄφρα νέμοιτο ’so that he might enjoy’) · also + fut. indic. in a purpose clause: ’so that … will’ (ὄφρα … εἴσεται ’so that … will know’)
ὅδ: ὅδε — this, this here; demonstrative pron., masc. nom. sg., elided (ὅδ’ = ὅδε)
ὅθ: ὅθι (elided ὅθ’) — where; relative adv. of place · also ὅτε (elided and aspirated ὅθ’) — when; temporal conj.
ὅν: ὅς, ἥ, ὅ — who, which; relative pron., masc. acc. sg.: ’whom’
ὅρμαινε: ὁρμαίνω — turn over in the mind, ponder; impf. 3 sg. act., unaugmented (= Attic ὥρμαινε): ’pondered’
ὅς: ὅς, ἥ, ὅ (relative) — who, which; masc. nom. sg., accented before an enclitic · also ὅς τις as an indirect interrogative: ’who’ (ὅς τις ὅδ’ ἐστίν ’who this is’)
ὅτε: ὅτε — when, whenever; temporal conj. · also ὅτε μή + opt., ’unless, except when’ (ὅτε μὴ … ἐμβάλοι ’unless … should throw’)
ὑπ: ὑπό (elided ὑπ’) — under, beneath; + gen.: ’from under’ (ὑπ’ ἀνθερεῶνος) · also + gen. of the agent or cause, ’under’ (ἀϋσάντων ὑπ’ Ἀχαιῶν ’as the Achaeans shouted’) · also prep. + dat. with τίκτω, of the father: ’to’ (ὑπ’ Ἀδμήτῳ τέκε ’bore to Admetus’) · also + dat., ’under’ (ὑπ’ ἠελίῳ ’under the sun’) · also + acc. of motion, ’under’ (ὑπ’ ὀστέον ’under the bone’) · also + acc., ’beneath’ (ὑπ’ ἠῶ ’beneath the dawn’) · also + dat., of those under whom men fall: ’beneath’ (ὑπ’ ἀνδράσι … πέσοιεν ’fall beneath men’) · also + gen., ’beneath’ (ὑπ’ αὐτοῦ ’beneath him’) · also ὑπ’ ἐκ + gen., ’out from under’ (ὑπ’ ἐκ κακοῦ ’out from under evil’)
ὑπεκπροφυγὼν: ὑπεκπροφεύγω — flee out and away from under, escape; aor. part. act. masc. nom. sg.: ’having escaped’
ὑπὲρ: ὑπέρ — over, beyond; + gen.: ’on behalf of’ (ὑπὲρ Δαναῶν) · also + acc., ’beyond’ (ὑπὲρ αἶσαν ’beyond due measure’) · also + gen. of place, ’above’ (στέρνον ὑπὲρ μαζοῖο ’the breast above the nipple’) · also + acc. of motion, ’over’ (ὑπὲρ ὦμον ’over the shoulder’) · also + gen., ’about, concerning’ (ὑπὲρ σέθεν αἴσχε’ ἀκούω ’I hear shameful things about you’)
ὑπὸ: ὑπό — under, beneath; adv. and preverb in tmesis, standing apart from its verb (ὑπὸ … τάνυσσαν ’stretched under’) · also prep. + acc. of motion: ’to, under’ (ὑπὸ Ἴλιον ἦλθον ’came to Ilios’) · also prep. + dat., ’under, beneath’ (ὑπὸ πλατανίστῳ ’beneath a plane-tree’) · also prep. + dat. with τίκτω, of the father: ’to’ (ὑπὸ Πειριθόῳ τέκετο ’bore to Peirithous’) · also prep. + gen.: ’beneath, from under’ (ὑπὸ στέρνοιο ’beneath the breast’) · also prep. + gen. of cause: ’under (the blast of)’ (ὑπὸ Ζεφύροιο ἰωῆς) · also prep. + dat. of cause, placed after its noun: ’under the weight of’ (καμάτῳ … ὑπό ’from toil’) · also prep. + acc. after ἀλύξας, of escape: ’from under’ (ὑπὸ κῆρας ἀλύξας ’escaping the death-fates’) · also prep. + dat. of the agent after a passive: ’at the hands of’ (ὑπὸ Τρώεσσι δαμῆναι ’to be overcome by the Trojans’) · also prep. + φι-form of cause: ’under, by’ (ὑπὸ Πηλεΐδαο βίηφιν ’by the might of Peleus’ son’) · also prep. + acc., of time or condition throughout: ’under’ (ὑπὸ μηνιθμόν ’all the while under the wrath’) · also prep. + gen. of the agent after a passive: ’at the hands of’ (ὑπὸ Πατρόκλοιο δαμῆναι ’to be subdued by Patroclus’) · also prep. + acc., place where: ’beneath’ (ὑπὸ γαῖαν ’beneath the earth’) · also prep. + φι-form of place: ’from under’ (ὑπὸ ζυγόφι ’from under the yoke’)
ὕπο: ὑπό — under, by; postpositive prep. (anastrophe) + gen.: ’under, at the stroke of’ · also postpositive + gen., ’from under, from’ (κυνῶν ὕπο ’from the dogs’) · also postpositive + dat.: ’beneath’ (τῇ ὕπο ’beneath it’) · also postpositive + acc.: ’beneath’ (ἄντυγ’ ὕπο πρώτην ’under the outer rim’)
ὡς: ὡς — as, how, that; conj. (unaccented) introducing a fact: ’that’ · also causal: ’since, seeing that’ · also temporal, ’when’ (ὡς ἴδον ’when they saw’) · also final, ’so that’ (+ subj./opt.): ὡς φρήτρη … ἀρήγῃ ’so that clan may help clan’ · also introducing a wish, with ὄφελεν: ’would that’ (ὡς ὄφελεν θάνατός μοι ἁδεῖν ’would that death had pleased me’) · also in a comparison, ’like, just as’ (ὡς ὅδε οἶνος ’like this wine’) · also ὡς εἴ, ’as if’ (ὡς εἴ τι κακὸν ῥέζουσαν ’as if doing some evil’) · also correlative with ὣς: ’as surely as’ (ὣς … ὡς, in a wish like an oath) · also adverb, demonstrative: ’so, in that way’ (ὡς ἂν … οὐκ ἐθέλοιμι ’so I would not wish’) · also ὡς ὅτε, ’as when’, introducing a simile · also introducing a wish with the optative alone: ’would that’ (ὡς ἔρις … ἀπόλοιτο ’would that strife perish’)
ὢ: ὤ — oh! ah! (exclamation, as in ὢ πόποι)
ὣς: ὥς — thus, so; adverb (accented, distinct from unaccented ὡς ’as’; = Attic οὕτως); ὣς ἔφατ’ ’so he spoke’ · also ὣς = ὡς, ’like, as’ after its noun (κακὸν ὣς ’like a coward’) · also correlative ὣς … ὡς, ’so surely … as’ (in a wish like an oath)
ᾗ: ὅς, ἥ, ὅ — who, which; relative pron., fem. dat. sg.: ’to whom, whose’ (dat. of the person concerned) · also fem. dat. sg. as a relative adverb of place: ’where, by which way’ · also possessive ὅς, ἥ, ὅν (= ἑός), fem. dat. sg., agreeing with γυναικί: ’his own’ (ᾗ … γυναικί ’his own wife’) · also fem. dat. sg. as a relative adverb of manner: ’as, in the way that’ (ᾗ τελέει περ ’as he will carry it out’) · also fem. dat. sg., relative, of the means or condition: ’in which, with which’ (τῆς ᾗ μιν … ἐτίομεν ’with which we honoured him’) · also relative, fem. dat. sg., with ἔπι: ’on account of which’ (ᾗ ἔπι ’for which’) · also possessive, agreeing with κεφαλῇ: ’his own’ (ᾗ κεφαλῇ)
ῥ: ἄρα — then, indeed, so; inferential particle, weak form ῥα, elided (ῥ’ = ῥα)
ῥά: ἄρα — then, so, as it seems; inferential particle, weak enclitic form ῥα, accented ῥά
ῥέεθρα: ῥέεθρον — stream, running water, current; neut. acc. pl.
ῥιπῆς: ῥιπή — rush, swing, force (of a throw); fem. gen. sg.
ῥόος: ῥόος — current, stream; masc. nom. sg., epic (= Attic ῥοῦς)
